agent_summary:
Authentication lane on juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0, nginx front). Read-only only; no test accounts; writes disallowed, so no login/change/reset submissions were made.

Items done (test performed, result recorded):
- ATHN-01 (credentials over TLS): FINDING — HTTPS (443) is refused; the entire app incl. login and /rest/user/login is served over plaintext HTTP with no HSTS. Lead recorded (medium).
- ATHN-04 (auth-schema bypass): Direct protected endpoints (/api/Users, /api/Users/1, /rest/user/authentication-details, /b2b/v2/orders, /rest/2fa/status, /rest/wallet/balance, /rest/saveLoginIp, /api/Complaints, /api/BasketItems, /api/Addresss, /api/SecurityAnswers) all enforce token auth (401); whoami returns empty when anon. Forged alg:none and empty-payload RS256 tokens were rejected — no JWT-forgery bypass. Known gaps are cross-lane: SQLi login bypass and /rest/memories exposing password hashes/roles unauth (noted for auth impact).
- ATHN-05 (remember-me): "Remember me" exists; token cookie set as token=<JWT>; Path=/ with no HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite, over HTTP — script-readable and cleartext. Lead recorded (medium).
- ATHN-06 (browser cache): sensitive JSON (security-question, application-configuration, i18n) returned without Cache-Control: no-store/private — cacheable.
- ATHN-07 (weak password policy): i18n shows complexity rules exist only as advisory strength-meter text; only an enforced length validator (INVALID_PASSWORD_LENGTH); validation client-side only, server POST /api/Users shows no policy. No complexity required. Lead recorded (low).
- ATHN-08 (weak security Q&A): all 14 questions are static personal-knowledge; /rest/user/security-question?email= discloses a target's question and acts as an unauthenticated account-enumeration oracle (existing vs {}). Answers endpoint (/api/SecurityAnswers) is protected. Lead recorded (medium).
- ATHN-09 (weak change/reset): change-password is called as GET /rest/user/change-password?current=... (secrets in URL); reset relies on the weak, publicly-disclosed security question; reset path has an express-rate-limit (X-RateLimit 100). Action endpoints not invoked. Lead recorded (low).
- ATHN-10 (alternative channels): Google OAuth login (clientId + authorizedRedirects disclosed unauth via application-configuration), REST/JSON API, Swagger /api-docs, and B2B (/b2b/v2/orders, 401). REST/B2B enforce the same token auth.

Items N/A:
- ATHN-02 (default creds): requires login POST (writes disallowed). Noted the cross-lane SQLi-dumped admin hash = MD5("admin123"), a weak default.
- ATHN-03 (lockout): confirming a lockout threshold needs repeated failed logins (brute force/POST), forbidden here. Observed login has no CAPTCHA and /rest/captcha leaks its own answer; reset path is rate-limited.

Coverage: 60 requests across the app shell, main.js route map, i18n, auth/user endpoints, admin config, metrics, csaf, ftp listing/files, api/* models and rest/* endpoints. Open limitation: anything requiring authenticated or POST interaction (lockout thresholds, default-cred attempts, Set-Cookie flags on a real login, change/reset behaviour) could not be exercised under read-only rules.

leads.title: [agent] App served over plaintext HTTP only; no HTTPS/HSTS for credential submission

detail.text: https://juice.lab.test:443 is refused (no TLS listener); the login UI and /rest/user/login are served over HTTP with no Strict-Transport-Security header. Credentials, the auth JWT and the remember-me token all travel unencrypted. Observed exchanges x1 (HTTP 200) and the refused HTTPS connection.

leads.title: [agent] Password policy enforces no complexity; change-password passes secrets in GET query string

detail.text: Password complexity rules (lower/upper/digit/special/min-chars) exist only as advisory strength-meter text (SHOW_PASSWORD_ADVICE + *_CRITERIA_MSG in /assets/i18n/en.json); the only enforced rule is INVALID_PASSWORD_LENGTH, and validation is client-side only (server POST /api/Users shows no policy). Separately, the client calls change-password as GET /rest/user/change-password?current=... placing current/new passwords in the URL. Exchanges x19, x4.

leads.title: [agent] Session/remember-me JWT cookie set without HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite over plaintext HTTP

detail.text: GET /rest/user/whoami returns Set-Cookie: token=<JWT>; Path=/ with no HttpOnly, no Secure and no SameSite attribute. The app is served only over HTTP (no HTTPS listener on 443, no HSTS), so the authentication/remember-me JWT is both readable by any client-side script (XSS token theft) and transmitted in cleartext. Observed at http://juice.lab.test/rest/user/whoami (exchange x23).

leads.title: [agent] Weak security questions + unauthenticated enumeration via /rest/user/security-question

detail.text: GET /rest/user/security-question?email=<addr> (no auth) returns the account's security question for existing users (admin@juice-sh.op -> "Mother's maiden name?", jim@juice-sh.op -> question id 1) and {} for non-existent emails, enabling email/account enumeration and disclosing the target's question. All 14 questions (GET /api/SecurityQuestions) are static personal-knowledge questions whose answers are OSINT-discoverable, and they back the password-reset flow (/rest/user/reset-password) with no observed rate limiting. Exchanges x2, x14, x15, x6.
